asked.item: Same person messaging two Facebook Pages, we replied on each: counts once or twice
Do people who only comment count if we never answer them

verdict.reason: The Active contacts section states both that the same person on two Facebook Pages counts as two contacts and that commenters do not count until you reply.

steps.text: Each contact is unique within one connected social account.
If the same person interacts with two connected Facebook Pages, they count as two active contacts.
Someone who messages or comments on your posts does not count until you reply.
